newsitem.title: PAKISTAN: Pakistani stocks dip 1.51 percent on strike news.
newsitem.headline: Pakistani stocks dip 1.51 percent on strike news.

text.p: Pakistani stocks dipped under the 1,400-point mark on Wednesday amid depressed sentiment prompted by a opposition strike call, dealers said.

An opposition alliance led by the Mohajir National Movement said it would back a one-day strike on Thursday to protest at the killing of Murtaza Bhutto, estranged brother of Prime Minister Benazir Bhutto.

The Karachi Stock Exchange 100-share index fell 21.23 points, or 1.51 percent, to close at 1,381.96. Losers led gainers 160 to 57. Hub Power Co fell 1.0 rupee to 31.50 rupees and Fauji Fertilizer 2.0 to 69. -- Ovais Subhani 9221-5685192
